text:
Casey: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp causing duplicate deliveries in staging when we get short 429 bursts. Pattern: health probe forwarded to webhook pipeline + SDK retry creates doubled side-effects.
Nina: Which SDKs? We've had parity issues before with idempotency header defaults.
Casey: Node adds Idempotency-Key for POSTs, Go doesn't unless user passes one. The sampleapp prewarm uses POST for /deliver so Go clients end up duplicating.
Omar: Short-term: change sampleapp to use GET /health and never forward. Long-term: SDKs should send a best-effort "Retry-Token" header for all mutating requests unless explicitly disabled. Server can dedupe advisory tokens for ~3s.
infra-bot: [alert] 2026-03-23T16:10:00Z staging spike: /v1/deliver 429s p95-retry=280ms
Nina: Also propose standardizing retry algorithm across SDKs to decorrelated jitter. Current full-jitter caused synchronized retries. Suggest defaults: base=200ms, cap=1500ms, multiplier=2. Make it configurable via retry_config.
Casey: Agreed. Also add sampleapp env SAMPLEAPP_RETRY_TOKEN=true to opt-in sending Retry-Token during onboarding.
Omar: Backend plan: lightweight LRU keyed by Retry-Token fingerprint for 3s, emit metrics replay_dedupe.hit/miss. Treat Retry-Token as advisory; real Idempotency-Key still wins.
Nina: I'll draft SDK PRs for Node/Python/Go to add Retry-Token and switch to decorrelated jitter. Include examples in docs on when to supply persistent Idempotency-Key vs relying on Retry-Token.
Casey: CI test: simulate a transient 429 and assert sink only gets one side-effect when Retry-Token sent. We'll add the test to onboarding pipeline.
Omar: Action items: patch sampleapp (canary), backend LRU prototype, SDK parity PRs, and CI test. I'll watch staging metrics during rollout.
infra-bot: [update] sampleapp patch deployed canary=10%. Monitoring 10m.
